title: Confirm scope, owners and availability
description: Supervisor + all: confirm scope, dates, capacity, primary/backup and business priorities; baseline the four repositories

checks.label: Confirm the start date and actual departure time
Rank critical flows with business owners

acceptance: Signed scope and owner matrix; tracked task list; ranked critical flow list; shared location for the handoff pack

title: Verify access and team continuity
description: A. KHMIRI: verify successor access to GCP, Git, Azure pipelines/state, monitoring, private artifacts and support contacts

checks.label: Primary and backup test individual access

acceptance: Both successors use their own identities; access matrix records capability tested, approver and any gaps

title: Map the platform and critical interfaces
description: Both successors: trace source → ingestion → Dataform → consumer; inspect live configuration and operating history

checks.label: Record deployed revisions and actual schedules

acceptance: Environment/schedule inventory, deployed revision IDs, interface register and agreed freshness/recovery expectations

title: Walk through ATOM infrastructure
description: A. KHMIRI + departing engineer: explain ATOM modules, state/workspaces, deployment path and private dependencies; separately review unfinished INFRA

checks.label: Document state, workspace and approval route
Store unfinished INFRA code in a team-owned location

acceptance: Infrastructure operating guide; state location/ownership; INFRA status and backlog; safe baseline plan review

title: Trace customer and sales data
description: B. DJEMEL + departing engineer: trace one sales and one customer path; compile using verified environment settings

checks.label: Trace one customer and one sales path
Save the dependency graph and setup guide

acceptance: Dataform setup guide, compiled dependency graph and critical-table inventory. Gate 1: access and discovery complete

title: Diagnose ingestion and rehearse a replay
description: A. KHMIRI leads: paired ingestion diagnosis, malformed-file exercise and controlled replay

checks.label: Trace a failed object to its load job
Test malformed input in an isolated environment
Replay one bounded batch and reconcile results

acceptance: Ingestion runbook; job/object IDs; evidence of correct target and expected row counts

title: Understand datalake and incremental state
description: B. DJEMEL leads: initialization/datalake history, schema evolution and late/repeated inputs

checks.label: Document isolated restore and rerun steps

acceptance: Incremental-state catalogue and before/after checks; replay behavior documented per action

title: Rehearse deduplication and mapping recovery
description: B. DJEMEL leads; A. KHMIRI repeats: deduplication and master-record walkthrough

checks.label: Review synthetic matching and non-matching fixtures
Check master IDs, consent and deletion propagation

acceptance: Approved synthetic fixtures; expected master IDs; consent/deletion handling; mapping restore exercise

title: Document manual actions after changes
description: B. DJEMEL leads: manual actions after schema, fingerprint and business-rule changes

checks.label: Test a schema or fingerprint change
Record execution order and rollback steps
Validate downstream state and sharing impact

acceptance: Change checklist covering dependent tables, fingerprints, snapshots, mappings and exports; tested isolated example

title: Verify sharing contracts and monitoring
description: Both successors + interface owners: sharing contracts, delivery acknowledgements and monitoring

checks.label: Confirm consumer receipt and retry rules
Test alert delivery and missing-input detection

acceptance: Each critical interface has a named owner and retry rule. Gate 2: paired operation and runbooks demonstrated

title: Lead an infrastructure change
description: A. KHMIRI operates, departing engineer observes: low-risk infrastructure change through normal review, preferably in dev

checks.label: Review a low-risk dev infrastructure change
Use the normal approval and deployment route

acceptance: Reproducible plan, approval trail, deployment validation and rollback/revert evidence

title: Lead a Dataform change
description: B. DJEMEL operates, departing engineer observes: small Dataform change with impact analysis
acceptance: Reviewed compiled actions, regression checks, isolated execution and tested return to baseline

title: Run the failed-pipeline recovery drill
description: Both successors: failed ingestion and partial Dataform execution drill; backup takes lead

checks.label: Capture failed batch and invocation IDs
Let the backup diagnose and recover
Reconcile rows, keys and downstream disposition

acceptance: Timed diagnosis, bounded recovery, row/key reconciliation and no unapproved downstream replay

title: Rehearse export retry and customer deletion
description: Both successors: export retry/duplicate-delivery scenario plus customer deletion scenario

checks.label: Test deletion with synthetic customer records

acceptance: Delivery ledger and consumer reconciliation; synthetic deletion result; retention of request evidence without exposing PII

title: Prove backup-led recovery
description: Backup-led restore and release rollback rehearsal; supervisor reviews outstanding gaps

checks.label: Backup follows the restore runbook independently
Distinguish code rollback from data recovery

acceptance: Evidence distinguishes code rollback from data/state recovery. Gate 3: successors can operate and recover

title: Begin independent daily operations
description: Successors begin independent BAU ownership; departing engineer observes only

checks.label: Record source arrivals, jobs and quality checks
Operate without prompts from departing engineer

acceptance: First daily operating log, alert triage and documented decisions without prompts

title: Let the backup lead an incident
description: Continue independent BAU; backup handles an issue or isolated drill

checks.label: Backup handles an issue or isolated drill

acceptance: Backup competence evidence; response follows the written runbook

title: Complete three independent operating days
description: Complete third consecutive observed operating day; business owners review outputs

checks.label: Complete three consecutive critical daily cycles

acceptance: Three successful critical cycles/days where daily; rehearsal for less-frequent jobs; draft acceptance

title: Close gaps and prepare final acceptance
description: Resolve failed checks and repeat only affected exercises; archive knowledge in team-owned locations

checks.label: Close critical access and recovery gaps
Assign residual-risk owners, dates and workarounds
Verify shared documentation and machine continuity

acceptance: No critical access/recovery gaps; remaining backlog has owners, dates and workarounds

title: Sign off ownership and departure
description: Supervisor chairs final acceptance; identity owner executes the agreed departure procedure at the actual departure time

checks.label: Record supervisor decision and support ownership
Schedule access revocation for actual departure time

acceptance: Signed acceptance or explicit residual-risk decision; final owner/contact list; transfer/revocation checklist

title: Access & discovery
description: Both successors can reach tools with their own identities; actual schedules, state and critical owners are documented.

checks.label: Live schedules and state ownership recorded
Critical flow and consumer owners confirmed

title: Paired operation
description: Every topic in the draft has a written procedure and paired example.

title: Independent recovery
description: Successors perform reviewed changes and recovery; the backup can lead an incident.

checks.label: Data reconciliation and consumer checks pass

title: Ownership accepted
description: Critical operations are independently supported and the departure transition is ready.

checks.label: No open P0; other residuals explicitly accepted
Support and departure revocation have named owners

title: Production orchestration is unverified
description: Actual schedules, tags, release configurations and manual steps need live verification. Sample modules do not establish deployed wiring.
acceptance: Live inventory and successful execution evidence for every critical path.

title: Replay and recovery can change persistent state
description: Deduplication, snapshot timing and incremental history require bounded replay and separate data recovery.
acceptance: State catalogue and isolated restore/replay demonstrated.

title: Access may depend on the departing engineer
description: Verify personal approvals, integration credentials and machine-identity continuity.
acceptance: Successors can operate and all critical credentials have managed owners.

title: Setup guides are incomplete
description: Dataform and pipeline READMEs are generic placeholders.
acceptance: Fresh reader can follow team-owned setup, change and recovery guides.

title: Critical data checks need evidence
description: No assertion actions or inline assertions were found in the reviewed SQLX files.
acceptance: Critical reconciliation checks run and results are recorded.

title: Error sampling may leave alerting gaps
description: The checked-in Datadog sink samples 1% of ERROR logs. Verify deployed alerts and missing-input detection.
acceptance: Critical failure and freshness alerts demonstrated or accountable interim checks accepted.

title: Private artifact and pipeline dependencies
description: Verify access to LVMH modules/image and Azure credential custodians.
acceptance: Build/deployment access, support and renewal process verified.

title: Credentials-named file needs authorized review
description: The Dataform credentials-named file is tracked. Contents were not inspected for this plan; do not copy secrets into this workspace.
acceptance: Authorized classification; rotate and remove exposure if live secrets are found.

title: Unfinished INFRA code needs team custody
description: INFRA has no local remote and documentation includes planned, unimplemented components.
acceptance: Code and actual backlog are in a team-owned location.

title: Repeated ingestion and export effects
description: Snapshot ingestion and repeat delivery need per-interface replay and acknowledgement rules.
acceptance: Bounded replay, delivery ledger and consumer retry tests recorded.

title: Campaign attribution rule is provisional
description: The attribution window is marked provisional in constants.js.
acceptance: Business decision and value recorded, or follow-up accepted.
